python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')

    print('Shape:', df.shape)
    print(df.head(20).to_string())
    print('Columns:', list(df.columns))
"

python3 -c "

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
# Expense rows: categories in col 0, subcategories in col 1, amounts in col 2
exp = df[df[2].notna() & df[0].isin(['Housing','Transportation','Food','Entertainment','Savings'])].copy()
exp[2] = exp[2].astype(float)
print('Per-category totals:')
print(exp.groupby(0)[2].sum().to_string())
print()
print('Grand total expenses:', exp[2].sum())
"
